SYNTHETIC — fictional evaluation material.
Example Cloud Placement (fictional), licence DEMO-RA-004. Office: Suite D, Example Road, Demo Nagar. Laos IT role for Example Cloud Employer (fictional), Rs 55,000 equivalent monthly. Employment visa before departure. Fee ₹30,000 plus ₹5,400 GST, total ₹35,400; bank payment and receipt. A tripartite contract signed by employer, agent and worker is required before departure. Pravasi Bharatiya Bima Yojana (PBBY) insurance documented.
